assignments.essential_function: Understand a dataset before relying on it: profile its grain, keys, missing values, distributions, date coverage and useful relationships.
Profile dataset schema, grain, keys, missingness, distributions and relationships, then report quality issues and useful next analyses.

review: Read the complete unchanged skill. It profiles schema, grain, keys, nulls, distributions, time coverage and relationships, then proposes explorations and documents a dataset. Its own Tips explicitly identify the quality flags as heuristic, so fixed null/cardinality thresholds are prompts to investigate rather than correctness verdicts. No source corrections or behavioral overrides are required for this exploratory role. This is static review, not an executed accuracy benchmark.
